messages:
ravi-ops: Quick planning note: scheduling a coordinated maintenance to do GPU fan calibration + graceful reboots across sa-east1 and ap-northeast1. Window: 2025-07-09 01:00-03:00 UTC. Goal: reduce thermal spikes seen in last telemetry run. Cohorts: 3 nodes every 25m per region. Pre-seed KV 30m prior.
elaine-sre: Proposed flow: 10m canary (health + packet probe) -> drain cohort -> firmware fan-calibrate -> reboot -> 10m thermal sanity. Abort criteria: p95 tail-latency > 25% or thermal > baseline+6C.
omar-runtime: Runtime tweaks: lower max-batch-size to 16 during backfill, enable prefix-cache priming 20m earlier, and set routing-policy to prefer local warm fallback. I'll stage these 15m before first drain.
mira-support: Please confirm which customer pools so we can send targeted notices. I'll draft status page copy and an escalation matrix for enterprise contacts.
ravi-ops: Affected pools: shared-sa, shared-apne1. No dedicated reboots planned. Inventory check: no pinned tenants on the specific host blades. Mira post at 00:30 UTC?
elaine-sre: Runbook excerpt:
```
# canary
kubectl cordon canary-node-1
kubectl drain canary-node-1 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=60
sleep 600
# probe
curl -fsS http://internal-health/ready || rollback
```
omar-runtime: Cost impact estimate: expected token backfill ~0.7% for window due to prefix cache cold starts. Tagging billing-team; if >1.2% we stop and reschedule.
mira-support: Draft blurb: "Planned rolling GPU fan calibration in sa-east1 & ap-northeast1 01:00-03:00 UTC. Some requests may be routed to fallback pools; slight latency variance possible. No customer data affected." Will post at 00:30.
ops-bot: calendar created: gpu-fan-calibration-rolling (2025-07-09T01:00Z-2025-07-09T03:00Z). Reference: #INC000872345. Pager schedule preserved.
elaine-sre: I'll post canary telemetry (thermal deltas, p95, queue depth) at 01:10. If clean, start cohort drains at 01:15.
ravi-ops: Final checklist: pre-seed 00:30, runtime flags at 00:45, canary 01:00, monitor cost and thermal. Thanks team :thumbsup:
